PainPoints.title: If any of this sounds familiar, the problem usually isn't your budget.
items: You're spending on ads, but sales aren't growing at the same pace.
Your cost per acquisition keeps rising over time.
You keep changing creative or audiences without knowing the real reason results are weak.
Your campaigns perform well, but you don't know how to scale them without hurting performance.
PainPoints.closingBold: Strategy + creative + tracking + continuous optimization is what drives real growth.

Story.title: From running ads to building marketing systems
paragraphs: I started in digital marketing managing social media pages and paid advertising, and over time specialized further in performance marketing and media buying.
I've worked across sectors and markets — e-commerce, services, education and more.
With every campaign, I learned the problem is rarely the ad itself; it's often the offer, the funnel, the tracking, or how leads are converted into customers.
That's why my work today isn't limited to running ads.
Story.goal: My goal is to build a marketing system that's measurable, optimizable and scalable.

steps.title: Audit & Analysis
steps.description: We review your ad accounts, tracking systems, conversion funnel and creative performance to identify strengths and sources of waste.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.description: We define the target audience, the offer, the right channels and campaign structure aligned with your business goals.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: We build the campaigns, set up tracking systems, and put a clear framework in place for testing and measuring performance.

steps.title: Optimization
steps.description: We analyze data continuously, cut what isn't working, develop what performs well, and test new growth opportunities.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Once we reach a winning, repeatable formula, we increase budget gradually and deliberately, while protecting performance.
